quests.title: Restore Pelican Cove
quests.description: Clean storm debris and rescue wildlife along California's coastline.

entities.name: Dr. Marisol Vega
dialogue: Welcome back to Pelican Cove. We cleaned up the map so the surf stays on the shoreline and the beach paths are clear.
Please restore the coast by collecting debris and rescuing wildlife.
dialogueInProgress: All cleanup areas are reachable now: the station beach, the sanctuary trail, the tidepool cove, and the shoreline.
Look for trash on the sand and press E near rescued animals.
dialogueComplete: Beautiful work. Pelican Cove is restored and every habitat is safer.
You protected the dunes, the tidepools, the beach, and the California shoreline.

entities.name: Volunteer Kai
dialogue: No more random waves on dry sand. The tide stays where it belongs now.
The boardwalks and fences should read as intentional paths instead of stray planks.

entities.name: Tourist Maya
dialogue: The sanctuary path is easier to follow now, and the beach looks much cleaner.
I can finally tell where the dunes, sand, tidepool, and water are supposed to be.
